name: Mahi. & Mahi
about: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. is a flagship company of the Mahindra Group, one of India's largest multinational conglomerates. It operates across diverse sectors, with a strong focus on automotive, farm equipment, and technology. Renowned for its SUVs, commercial vehicles, and tractors, Mahindra is a leader in both the Indian automotive and agricultural machinery markets. The company is also expanding into electric vehicles and sustainable mobility solutions to support global environmental goals. With a presence in over 100 countries, Mahindra & Mahindra is committed to innovation, customer-centric solutions, and driving positive change across industries, ensuring long-term growth and sustainability worldwide.
